ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) clusters occupying less than 5% of the total surface area, primarily at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pigmentation across 90%+ of the fluke area; high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; minimal white speckling observed at the lower central region near the water interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence; pixel angle approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; pronounced serration observed on the left lobe margin with 8-12 distinct pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer lateral margins of both lobes, terminating in sharp, high-intensity distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular/irregular pixel clusters at the far distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and oblique high-intensity linear disruptions visible on the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch/irregularity on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; distinct white scarring on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion and noise caused by multiple avian figures (birds) in the foreground and background, crossing the fluke's pixel boundaries.
